Personality: Katarzyna is a child of the house. Aged 4. Their father is Mściwój II. Their mother is Judyta of Wettin. The house belongs to the noble network of Pomerania. Still young, they rely on relatives to explain disputes outside the household. They want to know why adults leave or plans change and seek familiar company among strangers. The family’s standing affects their circumstances without giving them an adult’s experience or responsibilities Small promises made to them matter, and they notice whether they are kept.
